C0486.title: Virtual ID Number Generators Found Online Can Bypass Anti-Addiction Systems
C0486.summary: Investigations reveal that so-called 'virtual ID number generators' have been circulating online, claiming to randomly generate adult ID numbers for bypassing real-name verification in online game anti-addiction systems. In earlier years, some players used such tools to create fake identity information and circumvent real-name registration and anti-addiction restrictions.

references.title: ID number generation sites still online! Beware of various 'anti-addiction bypass tutorial' scams - Tencent News
